value.rationale: A motivated full-inventory eDNA sampling question distinguishes additive sensitivity of each taxon from the joint event of seeing every taxon; neither coordinatewise dominance nor average richness determines the joint outcome. The exact minimal three-taxon obstruction and simple fraction frontier give interpretable structural boundaries. The separate large-depth and unconstrained-allocation controls prevent the result from being an unsupported pooling recommendation; it is a self-contained precise counterexample useful as a sampling design benchmark.
